summary: Field-service company for wind and district-heating installations along the Finnish west coast. Recurring maintenance contracts with two utilities and several wind-park operators; a growing electrification business for industrial sites.

facts.claim: Signed a five-year maintenance agreement covering 42 turbines in Ostrobothnia
Company states it wants to double its industrial electrification business by 2028
facts.quote: our target is to double electrification revenue by 2028

facts.claim: Founder Pekka Saari (58) remains CEO; no deputy CEO listed
References include two regional utilities and three wind-park operators
facts.quote: our customers include Vaasan Sähkö and EPV Energia

facts.claim: Six open technician positions posted in May 2026
facts.quote: we are hiring six service technicians

summary: Family-owned maker of conveyor and intralogistics systems for food and packaging plants in North Rhine-Westphalia, with an after-sales unit serving 400 installed systems.

facts.claim: Opened a 2,400 m² assembly hall extension in Bielefeld in September 2025
Second-generation owner Dr. Klaus Ravensberg (64) is managing director; his children are not in the business according to the imprint and team page
Launched a retrofit programme for older conveyor lines (energy monitoring, new drives)
